context_requirements: Expression of soluble guanylyl cyclase subunits (GUCY1A3/GUCY1B3) or other cGMP-generating capacity
Intact cGMP effector signaling, especially cGMP-dependent protein kinase (PRKG1/PRKG2)
For apoptosis, intact mitochondrial apoptotic machinery and permissive TP53/RB status
For HIF1A-linked effects, normoxic or hypoxic HIF1A stabilization capacity
falsifiers: No change in cGMP-responsive immediate early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) at 6 h in any line
No apoptosis or proliferation-down signature at 24 h in lines with high GUCY1A3/GUCY1B3 expression
Strong proliferation-down signature at 6 h, which would suggest a non-cGMP off-target mechanism
No differential response between lines with high versus low soluble guanylyl cyclase expression

evidence.supports: YC-1, a soluble guanylyl cyclase activator, induces cGMP/PKG-dependent growth inhibition and apoptosis in MCF-7 and MDA-MB-468 breast cancer cells
YC-1 and cGMP-elevating agents activate PKG and induce apoptosis-associated gene expression in SW480 colon cancer cells
YC-1 modulates cGMP levels and affects viability/apoptosis in PC12 cells
YC-1 and cGMP analogs can activate pro-apoptotic pathways in cardiomyocytes at high concentrations
YC-1/PKG signaling modulates GATA-4 and survival pathways in cardiac muscle cells

changes: Removed MYC from proximal_down because MYC was also listed in proximal_up at the same time point; cGMP/PKG activation is not established to directly repress MYC transcription at 6 h.

Removed generic proliferation genes (CCND1, CCND3, CCNE2, CDK4, CDK6, E2F2, TFDP1, MCM3, PCNA, TOP2A, AURKA, AURKB, BIRC5, UBE2C) from proximal_down at 6 h; these are downstream/generic proliferation effects and should not be proximal to guanylyl cyclase activation.

Removed generic apoptosis/proliferation genes (BAX, BID, PMAIP1, CASP3, CASP7, CASP10, DFFA, DFFB, TRIB3, SESN1, SQSTM1) from late_up; these are generic stress/apoptosis markers rather than specific cGMP/PKG proximal targets.

Removed generic proliferation genes (CCNA2, CCNB1, CCNB2, CDC20, CDC25A, CDC25B, CDK1, PLK1, KIF20A, KIF2C, NUSAP1, BIRC5, UBE2C, TOP2A) from late_down; these are generic proliferation-down effects and not specific to guanylyl cyclase activation.
Kept only evidence abstracts that directly support the stated claims about YC-1/guanylyl cyclase activator effects on cGMP/PKG, apoptosis, and survival signaling.
